answer: Hollow Reputation Escrow: each identity gets a reputation balance held in escrow, released only in proportion to distinct counterparties who later transact with it. A swarm of clones converges on the same small cluster, so their escrow stays locked and never matures into usable credit. To fake breadth, the operator must recruit genuinely independent parties across a wide dune of activity, paying real fees each time. Every extra identity also forfeits its locked ivory balance permanently on collapse, making duplication a direct loss.
